nom: Sun Bum Baby Bum SPF 50 Sunscreen Face Stick

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with a child who has severe eczema found this stick did not trigger flare-ups, calling it eczema friendly.

concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a child suffering severe eczema reports no flare-ups after switching to this stick, describing it as a clean product that worked where others failed.

extraits.texte: I have 2 small children (3 and 1/5), our youngest has severe eczema and we've struggled to find him a sunscreen that doesn't cause him to have flare ups. After a ton of research I found this product at a local store and decided to try it. It worked fantastic! I was so happy to find a clean product that works for my children for all our future Disney trips!

Works! Reef Safe! Feels great! This stick is only slightly white for a few minutes while applying, which is helpful so you know you didn't miss a spot. Turns clear. My kids didn't mind the application and I enjoyed not putting germs and sand on my kids faces with my hands. No burns after a week long Hawaii vacation!!! Used the baby bum Mineral 50 lotion as well for the body. Both felt great on the skin compared to ALL other mineral sunscreens I have used in the past. Will be using Baby Bum sunscreens only from now on.
Only sun lotion I've used on my son (now 2yo). Never burnt once using the baby bum stick and he LIVES outdoors! Couldn't recommend more!

Bought for baby's first vacation in Florida. This was great for the ears and face. Our girl wasn't a fan of having to rub it in a little after using, but it was great for travel and quick mess free use.
I love this product. Great for forehead and no sweat dripping in my eyes.
The stick glides on well and rubs in easily. Just be aware it is small. Haven't had a chance to try it in the sun.

reserve: With only 8 reviews and just one mentioning a specific skin type or concern, coverage by skin type and concern is very thin.
